summary: Verified the user-reported 'result (1).docx cannot be opened by Word' bug via real browser download flow using Playwright. Both text.pdf and scan.pdf UI conversions now produce correctly named (text.docx / scan.docx) and structurally valid .docx files (zipfile.testzip() is None, python-docx opens cleanly, expected text present). Backend also validated: /api/pdf/pdf-to-word returns proper Content-Disposition and access-control-expose-headers: Content-Disposition when Origin header is present; pdf-to-excel with scanned PDF still returns a valid xlsx.
critical_code_review_comments: ToolPage.jsx is ~680 lines and contains many engine branches + ResultView; consider splitting per-engine option panels into subcomponents for maintainability.
pdf_to_word endpoint swallows pdf2docx exceptions silently; consider logging so future corrupt-docx incidents are traceable in backend logs.
_scanned_pdf_to_docx uses force_ocr=True even when a partial text layer exists; for mixed PDFs this may discard existing text. Current fallback logic (pdf2docx first) mitigates but worth documenting.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright is now installed in /root/.venv with chromium browser at /pw-browsers. Run UI test via: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/pw-browsers python /app/tests/ui_pdf_to_word.py. Backend tests: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_pdf_to_word_download.py -v. IMPORTANT: backend expose_headers is a CORS response header - requests must set Origin header to observe it.
rca of the issue: Root cause was two-fold: (1) browser fetch received Content-Disposition header but expose_headers didn't include it, so JS couldn't read the filename and fell back to 'result' - fixed via CORSMiddleware expose_headers=['Content-Disposition']; (2) OCR-produced docx sometimes contained illegal XML control chars that caused MS Word to reject the file - fixed via regex stripping in _scanned_pdf_to_docx plus a _docx_is_valid fallback path. Verified in real browser download flow: filenames now text.docx / scan.docx, zip integrity passes, python-docx opens files, expected text present.
